meaning: Multi-cycle constructor catalyst wear and periodic rejuvenation schedule benchmark across 5 model families (Theorem 81): with C_0 = 0, tau_cat = 1, and per-cycle wear delta = 1/3 (ceiling N_max = 3), Phase 1 separates 4 unscheduled wear cycles reaching 4/3 > 1 (Delta_E = -1), Phase 2 separates late rejuvenation after cycle 4 breach (terminal 1 <= 1, peak 4/3 > 1, Delta_E = -1), and Phase 3 verifies periodic rejuvenation within ceiling N_max = 3 keeping peak deviation at 2/3 <= 1 (Delta_E = 0).
